card.name: Scattered words in drug warnings
card.fires_on: No single word type; it fires on scattered small words and marks (In, of, including, can, a period, a digit) in drug-label warning text.

modes.label: Linking words in warnings
modes.description: Small connecting words such as of, including or can inside risk statements.
modes.example: Gastrointestinal Risk NSAIDs cause an increased risk of serious gastrointestinal adverse events<< including>> bleeding, ulceration, and perforation

modes.label: Digits and punctuation
modes.description: A digit inside a number or a closing mark such as a period or parenthesis.
